:::{#exm-lasso-soft-threshold}
#### Soft-thresholding three estimates

Under the conditions of @thm-lasso-soft-threshold with $\lambda = 1$:

- If $z = 3$, then $z > \lambda$,
  so $\eb_1 = 3 - 1 = 2$:
  the predictor stays in the model,
  with its coefficient shrunk toward zero by $\lambda = 1$.
- If $z = -2.5$, then $z < -\lambda$,
  so $\eb_1 = -2.5 + 1 = -1.5$:
  again shrunk toward zero by 1.
- If $z = 0.5$, then $\abs{z} \le \lambda$,
  so $\eb_1 = 0$:
  the predictor is dropped from the model.

With $\lambda = 0$,
all three estimates equal their least squares values $z$.
Raising $\lambda$ to $3$
would set all three to zero,
since then $\abs{z} \le 3$ in every case.

:::
